name: learning-populations
description: Self-play/adversarial population composition ops (W046): PURE typed pairing plans over W045 populations. composeSelfPlay(population, cohortPolicy) splits one re-proven population (W045's own whole-record validator, errors carried verbatim) into cooperating/competing cohorts AS DATA — cohort splits in canonical member order, the declared cooperation/competition structure — and seals the content-addressed selfplay-<digest> plan. composeAdversarial(champion, challenger) pairs champion-vs-challenger GENERATIONS (the challenger must be the champion's direct next generation; scope/world disagreement fail-closed) citing the W039 ablation/model-substitution vocabulary where applicable (the substitution citation is W039's own derived-origin shape). A14: COMPOSE typed plans — never execute, never train, never step worlds. R054: method-neutral. A9: same populations + same policy ⇒ deep-equal pairings, same canonical ids; input order never leaks.
